title: Streaming transcriber: endpoint segmenter, text normalizer and sherpa backend
description: Turn audio chunks into partial text and final timed segments using sherpa-onnx's streaming zipformer (goal 1). All timing/endpoint logic is pure Kotlin and unit-tested against a fake backend.
steps: Create `asr/TranscriptEvent.kt`: `sealed interface TranscriptEvent { data class Partial(val text: String) : TranscriptEvent; data class Final(val text: String, val startMs: Long, val endMs: Long) : TranscriptEvent }`.

Create `asr/RecognizerBackend.kt`: `interface RecognizerBackend : Closeable { fun acceptWaveform(samples: FloatArray); fun decodeAvailable(); fun currentText(): String; fun isEndpoint(): Boolean; fun reset(); fun inputFinished() }`.

Create `asr/TextNormalizer.kt`: `object TextNormalizer { fun normalize(raw: String): String }`: trim and collapse whitespace; if the text has letters and no lower-case letters, lower-case it, then capitalise the first letter and every standalone `i` (regex `\bi\b` -> "I") — only for text that was all upper-case; otherwise only capitalise the first letter. Empty stays empty.

Create `asr/StreamingTranscriber.kt`: `interface StreamingTranscriber : Closeable { fun accept(samples: FloatArray): List<TranscriptEvent>; fun finish(): List<TranscriptEvent> }` and `class EndpointSegmenter(private val backend: RecognizerBackend, private val sampleRate: Int = 16000) : StreamingTranscriber`. It keeps `totalSamples` and `segmentStartSample`. `accept`: add samples to totalSamples, `backend.acceptWaveform`, `backend.decodeAvailable()`, text = normalize(currentText). If `backend.isEndpoint()`: if text not blank emit `Final(text, ms(segmentStartSample), ms(totalSamples))`; then `backend.reset()`, `segmentStartSample = totalSamples`, and emit `Partial("")`. Else, if text differs from the last emitted partial, emit `Partial(text)`. `finish`: `backend.inputFinished()`, `decodeAvailable()`, emit Final for non-blank remaining text, then `Partial("")`. `close()` closes the backend.

Create `engine/sherpa/SherpaRecognizerBackend.kt`: `class SherpaRecognizerBackend(modelDir: File, asr: AsrFiles, numThreads: Int) : RecognizerBackend` building `OnlineRecognizer(assetManager = null, config = OnlineRecognizerConfig(featConfig = FeatureConfig(sampleRate = 16000, featureDim = 80), modelConfig = OnlineModelConfig(transducer = OnlineTransducerModelConfig(encoder = abs path, decoder = ..., joiner = ...), tokens = ..., numThreads = numThreads, provider = "cpu", modelType = asr.modelType), endpointConfig = EndpointConfig(rule1 = EndpointRule(false, 2.4f, 0.0f), rule2 = EndpointRule(true, 0.8f, 0.0f), rule3 = EndpointRule(false, 0.0f, 20.0f)), enableEndpoint = true, decodingMethod = "greedy_search"))` and one `OnlineStream` from `recognizer.createStream()`. Map: acceptWaveform -> `stream.acceptWaveform(samples, 16000)`; decodeAvailable -> `while (recognizer.isReady(stream)) recognizer.decode(stream)`; currentText -> `recognizer.getResult(stream).text`; isEndpoint -> `recognizer.isEndpoint(stream)`; reset -> `recognizer.reset(stream)`; inputFinished -> `stream.inputFinished()`; close -> `stream.release(); recognizer.release()`.

Create `asr/TranscriberFactory.kt`: `fun interface TranscriberFactory { fun create(language: String): StreamingTranscriber }` and in `engine/sherpa/SherpaTranscriberFactory.kt` `class SherpaTranscriberFactory(private val store: ModelStore, private val settings: SettingsRepository) : TranscriberFactory` returning `EndpointSegmenter(SherpaRecognizerBackend(store.bundleDir(bundle), bundle.asr!!, settings.settings.value.numThreads))` with `bundle = ModelCatalog.asrFor(language)`; throw `IllegalStateException("Model not installed: <id>")` if `!store.isInstalled(bundle)`.
Add `val transcriberFactory: TranscriberFactory = SherpaTranscriberFactory(modelStore, settingsRepository)` to `AppContainer`.
Write `asr/EndpointSegmenterTest.kt` with a scripted `FakeBackend` (a queue of (text, isEndpoint) returned per `acceptWaveform` call, records `reset()` calls) and `asr/TextNormalizerTest.kt`.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: three 1600-sample chunks with texts "HELLO", "HELLO WORLD", endpoint on the third -> events Partial("Hello"), Partial("Hello world"), Final("Hello world", 0, 300), Partial(""); `reset()` called once
Test: second segment's startMs equals the first segment's endMs (e.g. Final(.., 300, 500))
Test: an endpoint with blank text emits no Final but still resets
Test: identical consecutive partial texts are emitted once
Test: `finish()` emits a Final for pending text with endMs = total audio ms
TextNormalizer tests: "  HELLO   I AM HERE " -> "Hello I am here"; "bonjour à tous" -> "Bonjour à tous"; "" -> ""; "Already Mixed" unchanged
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: Read the PRD model catalog for file names; `AsrFiles` is in `models/ModelCatalog.kt`. The sherpa classes used (all in `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx`): OnlineRecognizer, OnlineRecognizerConfig, OnlineModelConfig, OnlineTransducerModelConfig, FeatureConfig, EndpointConfig, EndpointRule, OnlineStream. Named args shown above match sherpa-onnx 1.13.8. | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` classes in unit tests and only reference them inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
